summary: The hugepage code (hugetlb.c) in Linux kernel 2.6, possibly 2.6.12 and 2.6.13, in certain configurations, allows local users to cause a denial of service (crash) by triggering an mmap error before a prefault, which ca…
description: The hugepage code (hugetlb.c) in Linux kernel 2.6, possibly 2.6.12 and 2.6.13, in certain configurations, allows local users to cause a denial of service (crash) by triggering an mmap error before a prefault, which causes an error in the unmap_hugepage_area function.

description: The SISCO OSI stack for Windows, as used by MMS-EASE 7.10 and earlier, AX-S4 MMS 5.01 and earlier, AX-S4 ICCP 3.0103 and earlier, and the ICCP Toolkit for MMS-EASE 4.10 and earlier, allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (process crash) via certain network traffic, as demonstrated using a Nessus scan.
